_doc: Canonical stage list for the talking-video world: one or more recordings of someone speaking to camera -> one edited, captioned video. There is no short/long switch — the output orientation follows the source (reframe.py reads it), and every stage runs for both. Read by scripts/run.py; mirrors SKILL.md steps 3-11. `run` is the argv to spawn (cwd = skill dir), with {work} {source} {language} {skill} {ffmpeg} {ffprobe} substituted ({ffmpeg}/{ffprobe} resolve via lib/platform.py - $VEVO_FFMPEG / $VEVO_FFPROBE else PATH, issue #44). A stage with no `run` is a checkpoint: `block:true` halts run.py until `makes` exists (a genuine human decision); a checkpoint with no `makes` is advisory - printed once, never blocks. A stage runs when any `makes` path is missing or older than any `needs` path; else it is skipped. `needs`/`makes` are work-relative; a trailing / means 'non-empty directory'. `when` gates a stage on a project.config.json value.

stages.title: Nudge each cut-in onto a clean frame
stages.note: Audio silence alone doesn't know the speaker is still moving / blurry at the cut. settle_check.py moves each segment start to the first sharp, low-motion frame (cap cut.padIn). Config: cut.settle=false skips it. --force redoes it from scratch (after a fresh plan_cuts.py).

stages.title: Correct the transcript (Claude, whole pass)
stages.note: Claude re-reads the WHOLE transcript. Every incoherent / garbled sentence: recover what was said, else reword it correctly in the video's own language and register (darija stays darija). Write build/transcript-fixes.json ({fix:[[...]], hot:[...]}) - one entry per Whisper segment; the per-sentence word count does NOT have to match Whisper anymore (captions.py spreads reworded sentences). Not a line-by-line session with the user - show a summary. See SKILL.md step 5.

stages.title: Finalize the script - repeats gone, then your edits
stages.note: No detection script. Claude reads build/captions.json itself, finds every repeated/abandoned attempt at the same idea (keeping the LAST one as the real source), and calls `uv run scripts/retakes.py <work> apply` with build/retake-cuts.json it wrote itself ({cuts:[{s,e,text,reason}]}) - retakes.py only does the timeline surgery, no guessing. Genuinely unsure about a passage -> ask the user, with the exact timestamps and both texts, don't guess. THEN run `edit_script.py show`, show the numbered (now-clean) script, and drop any whole unwanted sentence the creator asks for - before scene design, because a drop shifts every downstream timestamp. Recap what was auto-removed AFTER, not before. Nothing to cut -> continue. See SKILL.md step 6.

stages.title: Jump-cut + filler pass
stages.note: Run `uv run scripts/tighten.py <work>` to propose word-level cuts (inter-phrase gaps > tighten.pauseMs, fillers from scripts/fillers.json). Show the user the summary, then `tighten.py <work> apply` folds it into build/cut-plan.json + build/captions.json.

stages.title: Chapter markers
stages.note: Optional, and only worth proposing on a long recording. Read the transcript, propose chapter breaks to the user, write config/chapters.json ([{ref, title}] - ref binds to a caption sentence). No file -> one continuous video, no markers.

stages.title: Design the scenes
stages.note: The core creative step. Either author config/scenes.json (motif names from scripts/motifs/index.json, params bound to build/captions.json) or rewrite the scene components in <work>/remotion/src/Scenes.tsx. A scenes-less project renders with captions only - that is a valid choice, not a skip. See SKILL.md step 8.

stages.title: Place the sound cues
stages.note: Author build/sound-cues.json - at minimum {"outro": <end-card seconds>}, plus whoosh/thud/tap arrays at meaningful moments (<= 15 events/min, rule #1). See SKILL.md step 9.
